direction: Character-led fantasy thriller, not a generic apocalypse or cheap shock. Keep reveals earned and irreversible choices costly.

episodes.title: THE FIRST SUN
episodes.premise: Lyra discovers Earth is peaceful yet incomprehensible; Mira's command is exposed by her unfamiliar behavior. Neither can simply swap back.

beats.heading: A WORLD WITHOUT WAR
beats.caption: Lyra watches a sunrise that Noctaris never had.
beats.voiceover: Lyra: What kind of magic is this?
beats.shot: Lyra in Mira's physical body stares at the morning sun beyond an ordinary apartment window. Her fear melts into wonder.

beats.heading: THE PHOTO
beats.caption: On the table, she recognizes a young soldier's face.
beats.shot: Lyra examines the photo of Mira and missing Eli. She recognizes the same face from a Noctaris scout she met, but doesn't know the person behind it.

beats.heading: THE WAR COUNCIL
beats.caption: Mira cannot understand the officers' words.
beats.shot: Mira in Lyra's armored body is pushed before a strategy table with maps. Soldiers speak Noctari. She cannot understand the dialogue.

beats.heading: SOMEONE NOTICES
beats.caption: Captain Taren watches every movement.
beats.shot: Closeup of wary Captain Taren scrutinizing Mira in Lyra's body; she tries to speak but cannot form Noctari words.

beats.heading: THE GLASS IS COLD
beats.caption: The mirror refuses Lyra's touch.
beats.shot: Lyra presses against the now ordinary mirror. No light appears, proving the exchange is not a reversible open doorway.

beats.heading: A HORN IN THE DARK
beats.caption: Outside, war horns sound. Mira is expected to command.
beats.voiceover: Mira: I don't know what to do.
beats.shot: Mira at the fortress battlements witnesses gathering enemy banners and soldiers waiting for orders from Lyra's body.

episodes.title: THE SIXTH BELL
episodes.premise: At the fortress, ignorance makes Mira dangerous. On Earth, Lyra confronts modern life and realizes someone might be tracking her.

beats.heading: THE SIXTH BELL
beats.caption: A warning bell rings. Soldiers turn toward their commander.
beats.voiceover: Mira: Why is everyone looking at me?
beats.shot: An iron bell above the fortress sounds. Mira in Lyra's body sees soldiers waiting for her order, in a language she cannot speak.

beats.heading: ONE WRONG GESTURE
beats.caption: Mira points toward a bridge. Troops mistake it for an attack order.
beats.voiceover: Mira: No! I meant the families!
beats.shot: Mira gestures toward a civilian evacuation route, but soldiers misread her and advance on an exposed stone bridge.

beats.heading: THE COST
beats.caption: The bridge is lost before Taren can stop them.
beats.shot: From the battlements, a siege blast damages the bridge; soldiers retreat. No pointless gore, only clear consequence.

beats.heading: THE STRANGE CITY
beats.caption: Lyra learns that an open street is not a battlefield.
beats.shot: Lyra in Mira's body sees commuters and laughing schoolchildren in daylight; she instinctively moves into cover.

beats.heading: SOMEONE KNOWS
beats.caption: A figure across the street wears the mirror's symbol.
beats.shot: Lyra glimpses a messenger with the same sigil engraved on Mira's antique mirror. The stranger makes no magical gesture.

beats.heading: NOT MY COMMANDER
beats.caption: Taren lowers his voice. 'Who are you?'
beats.shot: Taren confronts Mira at a dark war-table, where both could be overheard. Mira realizes someone has discovered the switch.
